summary: Tested Emergent Google-auth booking gates, anonymous API protections, group-interest UI, logout response, and frontend production build.

minor.issue: Existing regression tests still assume anonymous booking/list access and fail during collection because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is not exported to pytest; they are stale relative to the auth-gated contract.

action_items: Update or replace test_booking_api.py for authenticated sessions and load the frontend env explicitly when running pytest.
Configure ADMIN_EMAILS before validating organiser review flows.
Run a live Google test-account callback to verify session exchange, profile prefill, authenticated booking persistence, and logout end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: auth/session uses synchronous requests.get inside an async FastAPI handler, which can block the event loop during Emergent auth latency; use an async HTTP client or isolate the blocking call.
seed_data_creation: None; no live OAuth account or production data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Anonymous /api/auth/me, /api/bookings, and /api/interests return 401; logout returns 200 and clears session cookie; browser booking required fields open Google prompt; frontend yarn build passes. Live OAuth callback and authenticated booking/admin flows remain untested because no Google test account or ADMIN_EMAILS is configured.
rca of the issue: The pytest failure is test-environment/fixture drift: the existing test module reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL directly from os.environ and expects pre-auth booking/list behavior, while the implemented API correctly requires a session. The browser click timeout after closing the Google prompt was caused by the test leaving the underlying booking modal open, not an application defect.
